description.narrative: Communities and people have better capacity to prepare for, adapt to, and mitigate the impacts of the climate & environment crises and disasters.

# of people in communities reporting improved and sustained capacity for climate change adaptation and mitigation, and increased resilience to environmental disasters. (baseline will be determined at inception phase)
Local actors have better capacity for principled humanitarian and development action, advocacy, defence of human rights, and representation of marginalized and vulnerable groups.

title.narrative: # of NGO, CSO and CBO repesentatives, representatives of authorities and duty-bearers

description.narrative: # of NGO, CSO and CBO repesentatives, representatives of authorities and duty-bearers that have incleased capacity for principled, inclusive and human-rights based humanitarian and development action (disaggregated by gender and role). (baseline will be determined at inception phase)

People and households access timely, efficient and relevant social protection, social services, psycho-social support, safe spaces and learning opportunities, which improve autonomy, well-being, and access to essential services and documentation.

# of people receiving access to relevant and timely protection assistance and psycho-social support, reporting improved well-being, and better access to essential services and documentation. (baseline will be determined at inception phase)

title.narrative: # of people receiving direct assistance via humanitarian programmes, disaggregated by region/country

description.narrative: The indicator documents the number of people directly reached via humanitarian programmes. This includes people provided with tangible goods and materials, services and supported through activities designed to raise knowledge, awareness and skills. The indicator does not count people reached indirectly, such as those benefiting from enhanced capacity of institutions, or those affected by policy changes.
